title: Modern Data Tools
description: Explore modern data integration and processing tools including SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and PolyBase.
longDescription: This module covers modern data tools for SQL Server including SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) for ETL/ELT workflows, PolyBase for querying external data sources, and an introduction to big data integration patterns with SQL Server.
whatYouLearn: Design and deploy SSIS packages for ETL workflows
Use data flow tasks to transform and load data
Query external data sources with PolyBase
Integrate SQL Server with Hadoop and Azure Blob Storage
